title: Amova Asset Management Asia Limited's deemed interest in UI Boustead REIT rises after S$2.2M unit purchase
body: Amova Asset Management Asia Limited's deemed interest in UI Boustead REIT rose after a party linked to the holder bought 2,794,800 units in a market transaction at S$0.7712 per unit, for a total of S$2,155,349. title: Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited's deemed interest in AEM Holdings Ltd falls after S$3.1M share sale
body: Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited's deemed interest in AEM Holdings Ltd fell after Fullerton Fund Management Company Ltd sold 491,000 shares in a market transaction at S$6.3676 per share, for a total of S$3,126,491. No shares are held directly. Total interest falls from 41,722,963 shares (13.07%) to 41,231,963 shares (12.92%).
deemed_interest_text: Temasek is filing this notification form to report a change in the percentage level of its deemed interest in Shares from 13.07% to 12.92% due to the disposal of 491,000 Shares by Fullerton as investment manager via market transaction. Temasek's deemed interest arises from the interests in Shares held by Venezio and Fullerton as follows: (1)  Temasek's deemed interest via Venezio                                                                                                            12.228%        (i)   Venezio has an interest in 12.228% of Shares.        (ii)  Venezio is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Napier Investments Pte. Ltd. ("Napier").        (iii) Napier is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Tembusu Capital Pte. Ltd. ("Tembusu").        (iv) Tembusu is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Temasek. (2) Temasek's deemed interest via Fullerton                                                                                                             0.695%         (i)  Fullerton has an interest in 0.695% of Shares as investment manager for various funds,               including funds in which Temasek through a subsidiary has an interest.         (ii) Fullerton is an indirect subsidiary of Temasek.                                                                                                                                                                                                ---------------- Total deemed interest of Temasek                                                                                                                                  12.92%                                                                                                                                                                                                ======== Fullerton is an independently managed Temasek portfolio company.  Temasek is not involved in its business or operating decisions, including those regarding their positions in Shares.
relationship_text: Tembusu Capital Pte. Ltd. is a subsidiary of Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited.
remarks_text: The percentage of interest immediately before and after the change is calculated on the basis of 319,041,936 Shares. In this Notice, figures are rounded down to the nearest 0.01% or 0.001%.  Any discrepancies in aggregated figures are due to rounding.

title: Loh Kim Kang David reports change in deemed interest in Centurion Accommodation REIT
body: Loh Kim Kang David reported a change in deemed interest in Centurion Accommodation REIT. The filing attributes the change to the payment of CAMPL's base fee by way of new units issued to CCIL. The transaction involved 3,154,094 units at S$1.0576 per unit, for a total of S$3,335,769. The direct holding is unchanged at 39,194,701 units. Total interest rises from 700,104,351 units (40.52%) to 703,258,445 units (40.62%).
deemed_interest_text: (i)   On 11 November 2026 (the "Transaction Date"), Centurion Accommodation REIT (“CAREIT”) announced via        SGXNet that the payment of manager's base fee ("Base Fee") to Centurion Asset Management Pte. Ltd.        ("CAMPL"), by way of 3,154,094 new units in CAREIT (the “New Units”) have been issued at an issue price of        S$1.0576 per unit to Centurion Capital Investments Ltd. ("CCIL"), an entity nominated by CAMPL to receive the        New Units in its place. CAMPL has on the Transaction Date sold the New Units which it is entitled to receive as payment of its Base Fee        to CCIL, a related corporation of CAMPL. In connection with the sale of the New Units, CAMPL has directed        CAREIT that such New Units be issued directly to CCIL instead of CAMPL. (ii)  Following the issuance of New Units, CCIL has a direct interest in 664,043,744 units. CCIL is directly wholly owned by Centurion Overseas Investments Pte. Ltd., which is in turn directly wholly        owned by Centurion Corporation Limited, which is in turn is 26.85% directly owned by Centurion Properties Pte.        Ltd., which is in turn 100% owned by Centurion Global Ltd ("CGL"). CGL is 50% directly owned by Loh Kim Kang        David ("Mr Loh"). By virtue of this, Mr Loh has a deemed interest in all of the units which CCIL holds under Section 4 of the        Securities and Futures Act 2001 (the "SFA"). (iii) Wong Wan Pei, spouse of Mr Loh, has a direct interest in 20,000 units, which are registered in her own name. By virtue of this, Mr Loh has a deemed interest in all of the units which his spouse holds under Section 4 of the        SFA.
remarks_text: (i)       Of the 39,194,701 units held by Mr Loh, 11,452,005 units are registered in the name of UOB Kay Hian Pte Ltd,            5,130,390 units are registered in the name of CGS International Securities Singapore Pte Ltd, 11,000,000 units            are registered in the name of United Overseas Bank Nominees (Private) Limited, 304,500 units are registered            in the name of Raffles Nominees (Pte) Limited and 11,307,806 units are registered in his own name. (ii)      The percentage of unitholding before the transaction is calculated on the basis of 1,727,980,750 units            before the issuance of the New Units. (iii)     The percentage of unitholding after the transaction is calculated on the basis of 1,731,134,844 units following the issuance of the New Units. (iv)    DBS Bank Ltd. and UBS AG, Singapore Branch are the joint issue managers and global coordinators and the           joint bookrunners and underwriters to the initial public offering of CAREIT.
change_reason: the payment of CAMPL's base fee by way of new units issued to CCIL

title: Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited's deemed interest in CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust rises after S$3.4M unit purchase

No units are held directly. Total interest rises from 1,673,676,918 units (20.98%) to 1,675,129,818 units (21.00%).

Temasek's deemed interest in Units arises through CLA Real Estate Holdings Pte. Ltd. ("CLA Real Estate"), Fullerton, and DBS Group Holdings Ltd ("DBSH"). ("Bartley").          (xiii)   Bartley is a subsidiary of Tembusu Capital Pte. Ltd. ("Tembusu").          (xiv)   Tembusu is a subsidiary of Temasek. (B)    Temasek's deemed interest through Fullerton                                                                                                0.342%          (i)      Fullerton has an interest in 0.342% of Units as investment manager for various                    funds, including funds through which Temasek through a subsidiary has an interest.          (ii)     Fullerton is an indirect subsidiary of Temasek. (C)    Temasek's deemed interest through DBSH                                                                                                       0.450%          (i)      DBS Bank Ltd. ("DBS Bank") has an interest in approximately 0.450% of Units.          (ii)     DBS Bank is a subsidiary of DBSH.
